body:
This would replace `\` with `\` on Windows. You probably intended to replace with `/` on every platform.

```suggestion
                        var projectFilePath = project.FilePath.Replace('\\', '/');
```
The variable `e` is declared but never used.

Since this PR also considers `.slnx`, we may want to clarify that having both a `.sln` and a `.slnx` can also result in this error. I think this may become a common error when users upgrade using `dotnet sln migrate` but don't remove the `.sln` file afterwards.

Also, it should be `GD.PushError` so the error shows in a toast notification.
